structuralGroups.label: Lamp Chapel / kitchen
structuralGroups.intention: Both see shutter response from different sides, then reunite at cargo port. Receiving and working positions do not collide. Warmth offers psychological relief, not guaranteed immunity.

structuralGroups.label: The Well / rim
structuralGroups.intention: Both can see the lower destination at once; one points out closet/bridge while the other follows it visually. No decor hides the quarry silhouette or landing.

structuralGroups.label: Charnel Court
structuralGroups.intention: Scout follows rim sightline while carrier chooses stair; both rejoin at c1 without a compulsory hold. Two people identify arena, exit and alternative before entering.

structuralGroups.label: Ossuary
structuralGroups.intention: One reads the one-person occupancy emblem while the other checks the opened route. P3 remains a latch, so leaving together is obvious.

structuralGroups.label: Bridge / Reliquary / Mourner
structuralGroups.intention: Reader can communicate while partner advances, or both read then travel together. Mourner payoff is visible through bars. No plate-holder job is fabricated.

structuralGroups.label: Upper galleries / key / Chime ladder
structuralGroups.intention: One locates key/ladder release while carrier waits in a useful overlook rather than blocking a mount. Both test loaded ascent/descent and item retrieval.

structuralGroups.label: Chime Hall / Bellkeeper
structuralGroups.intention: Reader/operator swap voluntarily; solo player can memorize and walk. Partner can see the set dials and stakes without receiving correctness hints.

structuralGroups.label: Pump / Salt Cellar / Sluice
structuralGroups.intention: One operates while the other handles optional forage/route inspection; both can leave immediately after latch. Players identify which remote bars changed.

structuralGroups.label: Cistern / Drowned Gallery
structuralGroups.intention: Pair chooses lower route for approach/return reasons and can exchange cargo outside the grate. They do not wait for nonexistent water level changes.

structuralGroups.label: Service spiral / overlook
structuralGroups.intention: Carrier takes spiral while scout may inspect overlook; reunion is gN staging. A player can decline the drop and still reach destination.

structuralGroups.label: Root Grotto / Listener recess
structuralGroups.intention: One inspects shelf/recess while other stages pack and checks exit, then roles swap. Long Court/spiral path earns information/loaded access; Cistern path earns direct low access.

structuralGroups.label: Pit / Vault / closet
structuralGroups.intention: One stages while other inspects/handles existing quarry resources, then swap. Loaded exit through closet/SC2 visibly repays exploration. Drop tests never require a revive-system change.
